title: The Runaway Pizza
description: A pizza delivery that walks itself to your door

fields.prompt: Pick something someone would yell when they are surprised.

template:
Every Friday night, {name} ordered a pizza, and every Friday night it showed up right on time. But this Friday, the pizza showed up on its own two legs.

"Delivery!" it yelled, kicking the door open. It was covered in {food} and wearing tiny sunglasses. "Sorry I'm late. I got lost on my {vehicle}."

{name} stared. "You're a talking pizza."

"And you're {adj}," said the pizza. "Now hurry up. We have to get to {place} before my cheese gets cold."

So they hopped on the pizza's {vehicle} and zoomed down the street at {number} miles per hour. Everyone they passed yelled, "{exclaim}" and ran inside to hide.

Halfway there, one {adj} {animal} jumped into the road and blocked their way. "Stop right there!" it said. "I am the best {job} in town, and I smell something delicious."

"This pizza is not for eating," said {name}. "It is for saving the day."

"Oh," said the {animal}. "Then I'll ride along." And it squeezed onto the {vehicle}, which went {noise}.

When they finally got to {place}, a huge crowd was waiting. The pizza took a deep bow and everybody cheered. It turned out the whole town had been waiting years for a pizza that could walk.

On the way home, the pizza gave {name} a high five. "Same time next Friday?"

{name} could not stop {verb.ingTense} all night long.
